description: This file defines the NoteEditPage widget and its ViewModel for editing notes in a Flutter application. It includes methods for loading, creating, saving, and deleting notes, along with a UI for editing note title and body.

classes.name: NoteEditViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel managing the state and operations for editing notes, including loading, creating, saving, and deleting notes.

classes.name: NoteEditPage
classes.description: StatefulWidget representing the note editing screen, supporting both creating new notes and editing existing ones.

methods.name: loadForEdit
methods.description: Loads an existing note by ID for editing.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Creates a new blank note with a generated UUID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current note, either by creating or updating it.

methods.name: _NoteEditPageState.initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, loading or creating a note based on noteId.

methods.name: _NoteEditPageState.build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the note editing page, including text fields and action buttons.

methods.name: _NoteEditPageState._confirmDelete
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog before deleting a note.
